name: New York University
meets_full_need_notes: NYU meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for all admitted domestic undergraduates. Since 2024, NYU has guaranteed free tuition for families earning under $100,000. The university has made affordability a major priority.
no_loan_notes: NYU has eliminated loans from need-based financial aid packages. All need-based aid is in the form of grants and scholarships that do not need to be repaid.

merit_thresholds.notes: NYU offers several competitive merit scholarships: the NYU Trustee Scholarship (full-ride), the Dean's Merit Scholarship, and program-specific awards. The AnBryce Scholarship supports first-generation college students.

ed_aid_implications: NYU offers Early Decision I and II (binding) and Early Action (non-binding). Financial aid packages are identical regardless of application plan. Students should run the Net Price Calculator before applying ED.
special_programs: NYU Promise (free tuition for families under $100k, no loans)
appeal_policy: NYU students may appeal their financial aid package through the Office of Financial Aid by submitting a Special Circumstances Review form with supporting documentation of changed circumstances.
